gen-gf-tiro-tamil-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and uncluttered, its curves stopping well short of the stem. Bespoke Sans keeps a long stretch of text moving smoothly, while Tiro Tamil above it swings hard between fat and hairline strokes.
gen-gf-tiro-telugu-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads crisp and refined, leaving generous space where each curve ends before the stem begins. Tiro Telugu above it is all hairline joins against heavy columns.
gen-gf-tirra-fs-literata: Contemporary and plain-spoken, Tirra leaves a bright gap at the mouth of every curve. And Literata, a serif with a gentle taper from stem to joint, gives the text a bookish, sophisticated depth beneath it.
gen-gf-titillium-web-fs-literata: Titillium Web leaves a clear, wide gap where its c ends, giving headings a clean, contemporary look against Literata's shimmer of weight. It earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-tomorrow-fs-literata: Literata brings sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones, with curves that stay wide open at the mouth. Over a longer stretch, that middling weight spread makes a classic serif feel sophisticated and easy to settle into, while Tomorrow stays above.
gen-gf-trirong-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and refined, with generous space between where each curve ends and the stem. Trirong is best at gentle arches that thin as they leave the stem; Bespoke Sans is best at staying crisp.
gen-gf-trispace-fs-literata: Literata reads bookish and sturdy, its curves wide open. Trispace spreads its letters apart with plenty of room around them, and that spaciousness is what the text serif underneath quietly rewards with its moderate thick-thin contrast.
gen-gf-trocchi-fs-bespoke-sans: Trocchi brings low-key thick-thin variation and counters that let the eye slip in and out, with a classic, authoritative feel. Bespoke Sans then carries a longer passage in sharp, refined lines, its curves stopping well clear of the stem.
gen-gf-trykker-fs-bespoke-sans: Trykker has curvy, unclamped letters with a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight, which lends it a literary, authoritative voice. But Bespoke Sans is the one to lean on for sharp, refined text, with generous space at every curve end.
gen-gf-tsukimi-rounded-fs-literata: Technical-pen steadiness, no swells anywhere. Literata then carries a longer passage with a tempered thick-thin variation that never hits razor-fine hairlines, so a classic serif keeps sophisticated, bookish text comfortable.
